title: Origin story: Fionn mac Cumhaill
description: Fionn burned his thumb on the Salmon of Knowledge and, sucking it, gained all wisdom — thereafter biting his thumb whenever he needed counsel. He led the Fianna, Ireland's warrior-hunters, through ages of adventure, and sleeps now in a cave, waiting to wake when Ireland needs him.
